articles.headline: Ukraine unleashes one of its heaviest drone bombardments, as Russia strikes Ukraine
articles.summary: Ukraine launched a major nighttime attack on a dozen Russian regions, Russian-held Crimea and the surrounding seas, and Russia attacked various regions of Ukraine, as their war grinds on.
articles._summary: Rescue workers put out a fire at a building destroyed after a Russian strike on Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine, on Friday. Kateryna Klochko/AP hide caption Ukraine launched a major nighttime attack on a dozen Russian regions, Russian-held Crimea and the surrounding seas, Moscow's Defense Ministry said Friday, in what appeared to be one of Kyiv's biggest drone assaults since the Kremlin's full-scale invasion more than four years ago. Russian air defenses intercepted 660 Ukrainian drones, Russia's Defense Ministry said. The previous biggest Ukrainian attack over the past year, as Ukraine has accelerated its drone development, involved 556 drones on May 17. In an effort to turn the tables on Russia's grinding war of attrition, Ukrainian long-range drones have been battering oil production and energy facilities behind the front line and deep inside Russia.

articles.summary: Micron's blowout earnings cap a year in which seven memory makers — the de-facto oligopoly behind DRAM and HBM — took control of what the AI race pays.
articles._summary: In June 2025, memory was still seen as a classic boom-and-bust business — one where high prices eventually cure high prices as suppliers add capacity or demand cools. The price of 64 gigabytes of DDR5 memory — used in high-end PCs and AI servers — has risen roughly fivefold in 12 months. And one company has built an empire on it. Micron Technology Inc. (NASDAQ: MU ) just posted quarterly revenue up 346% year-over-year to $41.5 billion, with data-center revenue near $25 billion — close to $100 billion annualized.

articles.headline: US sanctions Rwanda gold refinery accused of smuggling DR Congo's minerals
articles.summary: The US alleges Gasabo Gold Refinery smuggled at least 60kg of gold in early 2026.
articles._summary: The sanctions target Rwanda's Gasabo Gold Refinery The US has sanctioned a major gold refinery in Rwanda and two of its executives, accusing them of smuggling minerals from rebel-controlled areas of neighbouring Democratic Republic of Congo. Washington alleged what it described as a "network" was collaborating with the M23 rebel group, which commands tracts of DR Congo that are home to vast reserves of gold and coltan, a metallic ore key to making electronics. Despite overwhelming evidence from the likes of UN experts, Rwanda has long denied supporting the M23. The government there has not responded to the US' recent sanctions, but have previously described similar measures against Rwanda as unfair and one-sided. The sanctions, announced on Thursday, target the Gasabo Gold Refinery, its chairman Jean Malic Kalima and its general manager Bosco Kayobotsi.
articles._zh_headline: 美国制裁被指控走私刚果民主共和国矿物的卢旺达黄金精炼厂
articles._zh_summary: 制裁针对卢旺达的加萨博黄金精炼厂 美国制裁了卢旺达一家大型黄金精炼厂及其两名高管，指控他们从邻国刚果民主共和国叛军控制地区走私矿物。华盛顿声称其所谓的“网络”正在与M23叛乱组织合作，该组织控制着刚果民主共和国的大片地区，这些地区蕴藏着大量黄金和钶钽铁矿石，而钶钽铁矿是制造电子产品的关键金属矿石。尽管联合国专家等提供了压倒性的证据，但卢旺达长期以来一直否认支持“3·23”运动。卢旺达政府尚未对美国最近的制裁做出回应，但此前曾表示针对卢旺达的类似措施是不公平和片面的。周四宣布的制裁针对的是 Gasabo Gold Refinery、其董事长 Jean Malic Kalima 和总经理 Bosco Kayobotsi。

articles._summary: The trade that powered Wall Street for three years is having its worst month on record. MAGS has fallen more than 13% in June and has bled over $1 billion in net outflows month-to-date, according to fund-flow data from Tradingview. The slide dragged the fund into correction territory, down more than 14% from its May 14 record close of $70.94. Is the market’s elite group merely showing cracks, or has it already crumbled?

In a post on X, El-Erian said the biggest factor that could reverse gold’s recent weakness is “renewed, consistent central bank buying.” He added that lower oil prices could support that trend by easing pressure on many countries’ foreign exchange reserves, potentially allowing central banks to resume accumulating gold.
articles._zh_headline: Mohamed El-Erian 表示黄金需要一位关键买家才能摆脱 4,000 美元的暴跌
articles._zh_summary: 经济学家Mohamed El-Erian周四表示，在金价本周短暂跌破4,000美元/盎司之后，央行重新买盘可能会使金价摆脱近期的暴跌。 El-Erian 在 X 上发表的一篇文章中表示，扭转黄金近期疲软趋势的最大因素是“央行重新持续购买”。他补充说，油价下跌可能会缓解许多国家外汇储备的压力，从而支持这一趋势，从而有可能让各国央行恢复积累黄金。

articles.headline: Nasdaq Falls For Fourth Day Amid Decline In Apple Shares: Investor Sentiment Declines, Greed Index Remains In ‘Fear’ Zone

articles._summary: The CNN Money Fear and Greed index showed a slight decline in the overall market sentiment, while the index remained in the “Fear” zone on Thursday. U.S. stocks settled mixed on Thursday, with the Nasdaq Composite falling more than 100 points during the session despite a strong earnings report from Micron Technology Inc. (NASDAQ: MU ) . Apple Inc. (NASDAQ: AAPL ) shares fell more than 6% on Thursday after the company raised prices on several of its hardware products.

articles._zh_summary: CNN 货币恐惧与贪婪指数显示整体市场情绪略有下降，该指数周四仍处于“恐惧”区域。周四美国股市涨跌互现，尽管美光科技公司（纳斯达克股票代码：MU）发布了强劲的盈利报告，但纳斯达克综合指数盘中仍下跌超过 100 点。苹果公司（纳斯达克股票代码：AAPL）周四提高了几种硬件产品的价格后，其股价下跌了 6% 以上。
